svg.title: Check that a scheduled report reads fresh data
svg.desc: The practice file lists jobs marked waiting or done. A scheduled Devin session should count the waiting jobs at each run. First run. Two of the three jobs are waiting. The report should show 2. Change the input. Mark one of those waiting jobs done in the practice file. Next run. One job is still waiting. Check the report and which saved version it read.
svg.text: Check that a scheduled report reads fresh data
The practice file lists jobs marked waiting or done. A scheduled Devin
session should count the waiting jobs at each run.
Two of the three jobs are waiting. The report should show 2.
Mark one of those waiting jobs done in the practice file.
One job is still waiting. Check the report and which saved version it read.
